description: Defines data structures and logic for coupon feedback and error message mapping in the UI of a Kotlin-based frontend project.

classes.name: CouponUxFeedback
classes.description: Data class representing UI-oriented feedback for coupons, including type and message.

classes.name: CouponUxFeedback.Type
classes.description: Enumeration of the possible feedback types: NONE, APPLIED, INVALID_RULE, NETWORK.

classes.name: CouponErrorMessageMapper
classes.description: Object that maps backend coupon validation messages to user-friendly UI messages.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps raw backend coupon validation messages into friendly, user-facing text.
